parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem:
An isolated planet is a uniform sphere of radius $3.39 \times 10^{6} \text{ m}$. Its mass of $6.42 \times 10^{23} \text{ kg}$ may be considered to be a point mass concentrated at its centre. The planet rotates about its axis with a period of $24.6 \text{ hours}$.

For an object resting on the surface of the planet at the equator, calculate, to three significant figures:

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: the force per unit mass exerted on the object by the surface of the planet.
